2. How did the Census Report of 1901 contribute to the construction of colonial knowledge in
India, particularly in shaping British perceptions and definitions of Indian society?

4. Write short notes on any two of the following:
a. India Memory Project b. Cultural Memory and digitization.
c. Camera as a Technology of Rule d. Peasants and lived experience in elite nationalist account.
